mission: MASTER FINAL REPAIR MISSION — CT OPERATIONS MONITOR v11.3.1

issuesResolved.summary: Dashboard stuck on WAITING despite displaying operational metrics
issuesResolved.rootCause: East-3 dashboard.js had event listeners hardcoded to CT_EAST_2_* while content.js dispatched CT_EAST_3_*, preventing live update and heartbeat receipt. In addition, unchanged polling ticks suppressed observation timestamp updates in both dialers.
issuesResolved.resolution: Enforced dialer-specific event constants and implemented a deterministic 6-state connection state machine updating lastSuccessfulObservationAt on every observation tick.

issuesResolved.summary: Native CallTools Refresh button clicks during polling and manual refresh
issuesResolved.rootCause: content.js contained 4 call sites to button.click() on findNativeRefreshButton() and an automated 5-second periodic click loop.
issuesResolved.resolution: Permanently removed findNativeRefreshButton, refreshButtonBusy, finishRefreshVerification, and requestNativeRefresh. Replaced with 100% passive DOM re-reads via readAndPublish.

issuesResolved.summary: Inbound Not Answered vs Inbound No Answer fallback and Abandoned mapping
issuesResolved.rootCause: Ambiguity in native table header hierarchy between primary and fallback columns.
issuesResolved.resolution: Enforced strict priority: callsTodayNotAnswered (primary) -> inboundNoAnswer (fallback); never summed; never mapped to Abandoned; missing rendered as '—'.
